summary:
The sealed Jinshu 80 opening dates Wang Xizhi’s age as thirteen sui and ties later staff service to Yu Liang’s deathbed, but most Western intervals are invented career-spans rather than uncertainty about one event. Yu Liang’s deathbed memorial and death in 咸康六年 convert to AD 340, and his 征西將軍 tenure after Tao Kan’s 咸和九年 death supports a 334–340 window for the recruitment; Emperor Yuan’s 過江 and Wang Kuang’s advice belong to 永嘉元年 (AD 307). Closed ranges 316–322 / 317–322 for 幼 and 年十三 invent a start from dynasty founding or a reconstructed birth and ignore that 幼 precedes the visit, which is only bounded by Zhou Yi’s 永昌元年 death. 司徒導 and 尚書郎 are identifications, not dated service; Wang Dao became 司徒 in 太寧元年 (323), not 317. 時太尉郗鑒 cannot be 327–339: the Chengdi annals make Xi Jian 太尉 only in 咸康四年 (338) and record his death in 咸康五年. Wang Dun-circle dates 317–324 describe activity until 太寧二年, not the undated praise, clerkship, or 三少 remark. Hints must follow the supported personal events, not reign-long or dynasty-long activity. No birth year should be inferred from 年十三; s0021–s0022 remain undated after the 340 memorial.
Owned units s0023–s0044 contain no births, deaths, or ages. The sealed narrative dates Yin Hao’s first letter as 揚州刺史 before Wang Xizhi accepted 護軍, then a later 時殷浩與桓溫不協 cluster that ends in 浩遂行果為姚襄所敗. Jinshu 穆帝紀 (Emperor Mu of Eastern Jin, 永和) dates Yin Hao’s Yang appointment to 永和二年三月 (conventional AD 346), Huan Wen’s Jingzhou command to 永和元年八月 (345), Yin Hao’s first northern march to 永和八年九月 (352), Yao Xiang’s revolt and the Shan Sang rout to 永和九年冬十月 (353; proleptic Gregorian 永和九年 runs 353-02-20 to 354-02-08, so the tenth month remains AD 353), and Yin Hao’s dismissal to 永和十年二月 (354). Claim-153’s 351–353 window is Wang Xizhi’s own Kuaiji-period letters around that campaign and is supported. Claim-155 dates Wang Dao’s own recruitment attempt to 王丞相時, bounded by Eastern Jin preeminence and his 咸康五年 death (339), and is supported. Claim-173 and hints-p018 correctly give Yao Xiang’s own rout of Yin Hao as AD 353. Four clusters fail. Claim-169 and hints-p014 stamp Yin Hao’s 揚州刺史 attestation with Wang’s 351–353 Kuaiji slice, which is neither the 346 appointment nor the 346–354 tenure. Claim-170 and hints-p015 treat 尚子平之志 as Shang Ziping’s Guangwu-era life; the Chinese is Wang Xizhi’s later model-citation (retrospective), and AD 25–57 is a reign-span, not an event window (Hou Hanshu only has 建武中 for the wander story). Claim-171 converts 漢末使太傅馬日磾慰撫關東 to 189–194, but Hou Hanshu 獻帝紀 (Emperor Xian, 初平/興平) dates that mission to 初平三年八月 (192); 189 is the political start of 漢末, not this embassy, and hints-p016’s 192–194 still uses the 194 death as an activity end and contradicts the claim. Claim-172 and hints-p017 start Huan Wen’s 不協 at the 345 Jingzhou appointment, a different event; 殷浩傳 places the mutual suspicion after the Shu conquest, and this chapter’s 時 is the later Kuaiji/北伐 moment.
Owned units s0045–s0066 are Wang Xizhi’s counsel after a northern defeat and contain no births, deaths, or ages. Chen Sheng and Wu Guang appear only in the proverbial 勝廣之憂; Jin Shu 80 does not date their rising, so BC 209 is an imported Shiji year applied to a later Qin-rebellion allusion and cannot stand as their own event or as an active hint. Yao and Shun are explicitly 古人 / 往代 exemplars, so legendary antiquity is supported. The letter 又與會稽王箋, and Wang’s 今 / 當今 in that letter, belong to the Prince of Kuaiji as addressee and to Wang as author: the same cluster already has 今軍破於外 while 殷浩、荀羨 are still to be recalled. Jin Shu 8 and Zizhi Tongjian place Hao’s Yao Xiang defeat in winter Yonghe 9 and his dismissal in Yonghe 10/II; conventional Eastern-Jin 永和九年–十年 are AD 353–354, and the Chinese year itself straddles those Western years, so the 353–354 window is uncertainty about one letter, not a dynasty span. Wang’s 353–355 hint matches that letter plus the later famine window and the Yonghe 9 Lanting context.
Owned units s0067–s0088 are Wang Xizhi’s Kuaiji-period counsel: a letter to the Prince of Kuaiji about Yin Hao’s northern deployments, then famine relief and a letter headed 尚書僕射謝安. No owned unit states a birth, death, age, or reign-year for p025, p026, p027, or p030. Claims 195 and 199 convert the letter’s deictic 今/當今 into a closed AD 353–354 interval; Jinshu 8 places Hao and Xun Xian in the field from Yonghe 8 (conventional AD 352) and strips Hao only in Yonghe 10/II (AD 354), so both endpoints are unargued and the window reads like campaign activity rather than uncertainty about one letter. Claims 204 and 242, and the matching active hints, treat 伍員之憂不獨在昔 and 蹈東海 as explicit Spring-and-Autumn / Warring-States life dates (BC 522–484; BC 284–260). The Chinese marks those passages as ancient exempla inside an Eastern Jin letter; the imported years are not in the source, 522 is Wu Yuan’s Zuozhuan flight rather than a birth, and 284–260 does not match Lu Zhonglian’s Handan 蹈東海 speech after Changping. Claim 215 dates 時東土饑荒 to AD 353–355 without a source year, using a tenure-like span. Claim 236 dates Xie An’s receipt of a puye letter to AD 353–355, which the same chapter contradicts (謝安未仕時亦居焉) and which Jinshu 8–79 assign to Xie Shang in Yonghe, not to Xie An. All ten owned items and all four owned people therefore fail; later reception must stay a retrospective event and must not feed active hints.
Independent review of Jinshu ch. 080 units s0089–s0110 against the sealed Chinese only. These twenty-two units are continuous memorial counsel on grain transport, year-end ranking, contradictory paperwork, granary theft at Yuyao, corvée desertion, and commuting lighter capital and five-year sentences into labor. unitPeople lists no named person in any owned unit; ownedItems and ownedPeople are empty, so no itemChecks or personChecks were due. Date-like Chinese in the slice is administrative or relative, not a named person's birth, death, age, or dated life event: 歲終 (s0089) is a yearly evaluation cycle; 自吾到此 (s0092) marks tenure since an unnamed posting without a reign, era, or year; 十日 (s0094) is uninterrupted work time; 江左平日 (s0096) is a general contrast with ordinary Jiangzuo practice; 近 (s0098) and 近十萬斛 (s0099) are recency and quantity; 自軍興以來 and 死亡 (s0100) plus 死亡絕沒 and 十年、十五年 (s0105) describe anonymous wartime attrition and decade-long cases, not a named death or traditional age; 五歲刑 and 自今 (s0106) are a penalty term and a prospective policy. Context units s0080 and s0086–s0088 / s0111–s0113 name the Prince of Kuaiji, Lu Zhonglian, Wang Xizhi, Xie An, and the Kuaiji literary circle, but those units and people are outside this job. No omitted personal chronology was found in the owned slice, and no conversion or external calendar check was required.
Only Wang Xizhi’s (p028) Orchid Pavilion preface and gathering are securely dated. Sealed 永和九年，歲在癸丑，暮春之初 belongs to that event; Eastern Jin Mu’s Yonghe 9 is the guichou year AD 353. Late spring of that lunar year stays inside AD 353 in both Julian (Academia Sinica’s pre-1582 default) and proleptic Gregorian, so the year-precision Western year is justified. Every other owned date is unsupported. Xie An’s 未仕時 is a relative phrase, not a convertible year: 345–360 invents both ends and treats residence as a period window. 孫綽、李充、許詢、支遁 are named only as eastern literary peers; 永和九年 dates the gathering, and the passage does not name them there. p035’s Yonghe 9 row cites preface sentences that neither name 羲之 nor contain the year, duplicating p028’s event. 東晉永和前後 and 353–355 on the later anecdotes and the goose-keeping widow are not in the Chinese. 齊彭殤 and 金穀詩序 are later or proverbial references, not Peng Zu’s, Pan Yue’s, or Shi Chong’s living activity, and 296–300 is likewise absent. Owned units state no births, deaths, or numerical ages for the owned people. Active hints repeat the defective years and must be cleared or, for p035, reduced to the context-supported Yonghe 11 resignation rather than Lanting.
Owned units s0133–s0154 contain no birth years and only two life-stage facts: Wang Xizhi’s 暮年 in s0149, and Wang Shu’s 母喪 in s0153. The qualitative age claim for Wang Xizhi is supported. Every other owned date is unsupported. The Shanyin Daoist, disciple, disciple’s father, fan-selling woman, and Wang Shu’s mother are given a fabricated source label 東晉永和前後 and a closed AD 353–355 window drawn from the Lanting year and Wang Xizhi’s later oath, not from these 嘗 anecdotes; 累年 in the Wang Shu episode also makes a 353–355 death for the mother too late. Zhong Yao and Zhang Zhi appear only inside Wang Xizhi’s (and Yu Yi’s) later comparisons; Cao Wei 200–230 and late-Han 168–192 are imported life windows, not their own dated events. Yu Yi, Xi Yin, and Yu Liang receive dynasty-wide career intervals that the chapter never states. Wang Shu’s attestation is labeled 永和十一年/AD 355, but that year in this biography dates Wang Xizhi’s grave oath; the Mu-emperor annals place Wang Shu’s Yang appointment in 永和十年 (conventional AD 354). Active hints copy the same invented endpoints and must not stand as living activity.
Wang Xizhi's illness plea, resignation from Kuaiji, and tomb-side oath are his own events, dated in the chapter to 東晉穆帝永和十一年三月癸卯朔九日辛亥. That ganzhi pair matches the third month of Yonghe 11. The conventional Western year of Yonghe 11 is AD 355; the dated day falls in AD 355 on both the Julian table (355-04-07) and proleptic Gregorian (355-04-06). A later 告誓文 anecdote that reads 永和十年 is calendrically incompatible with 癸卯朔 and does not override the chapter. Several other dated rows do not survive. s0156 never says 永和十一年; Wang Shu's Yang appointment is narratively earlier than the oath, and 晉書穆帝紀 places it in 永和十年二月 (AD 354). Tan is only named in a comparison, not as an actor in 355. 夙遭閔凶 and 母兄鞠育 do not yield an AD 317–345 activity window; that span is an Eastern-Jin dynasty bracket, not uncertainty about one event. 于父母墓前 shows both parents already dead by the oath, so the mother's death is omitted while the father's early death is otherwise attested. 老氏 and 周任 are retrospective citations inside the 355 oath, not Spring-and-Autumn or Western-Zhou life dates. 羲之既去官, the Xu Mai travels, and Xie An's 嘗謂 remark are one-sided after the resignation, not an exact AD 355 year, and they must not feed living activity hints.
Owned units s0178–s0199 contain no birth, death, or age figures. The only explicit Chinese date-bearing life events are Liu Tan as 丹陽尹 with Xu Xun lodging and Wang Xizhi present; Wang Xizhi at leisure writing to Xie Wan as 吏部郎, then again after Xie Wan became 豫州都督; and a counterfactual naming of Chao Fu, Xu You, Ji, and Qi plus a retrospective naming of Lu Jia, Ban Si, and Yang Wangsun. The 345–349 Danyang window is not in the chapter and conflicts with the dated 永和三年十二月 appointment in 建康實錄, while 資治通鑑 already sends Liu Tan to 沔中 in 永和元年, so AD 345 is not a safe start for this capital gathering. Wang’s leisure start in conventional AD 355 follows the chapter’s own 永和十一年 vow, but the AD 361 end is not in 年五十九卒 and should not be treated as an explicit year; 書斷’s 昇平五年卒 is a later witness among competing death-year reconstructions. Xie Wan’s Yuzhou appointment and the second letter belong to 升平二年 (AD 358) in 晉書·穆帝紀 and 資治通鑑, not the exact year AD 359 used here; the defeat is 升平三年. Lu Jia, Ban Si, and Yang Wangsun are reception-only names in Wang’s letter; the imported Han floruits are not this chapter’s events and must not feed active hints.
Jinshu 80 units s0200–s0221 support Xie Wan’s 升平三年 defeat (AD 359), Wang Xizhi’s death age of 59 sui without a source year, Wang Ningzhi’s killing and Sun En’s Kuaiji attack in 隆安三年 (AD 399), and Wang Huizhi’s staff service under Grand Marshal Huan Wen during 興寧–寧康 (AD 363–373). They do not support AD 361 as Xizhi’s death or honor year (年五十九卒 has no reign year; 真誥’s 升平五年 competes with other witnesses), the invented 340–361 window on 玄之早卒, the 355–399 career span on 子 凝之 / 仕歷…, or dating 車騎桓沖 and Huizhi’s cavalry post to 373–384 (in 寧康元年 Chong was 中軍將軍; 車騎 begins 寧康三年 / 太元元年). Active hints must follow those corrections.
Owned units s0222–s0243 state no birth, age, or Chinese calendar year. They do record Huizhi's undated bamboo and Shan-yin anecdotes, Dai Kui then in Shan, a night reading of 高士傳贊 that names 井丹 and 長卿, Huizhi as 黃門侍郎 who 棄官東歸, joint critical illness, 獻之卒, and Huizhi's 月餘亦卒 from a burst back abscess. Every supplied Western interval is invented: AD 270–300, 58–88, and BC 179–117 date later quotations of Zuo Si, Jing Dan, and Sima Xiangru as if they were those men's lives; AD 360–395 and 370–386 close undated Dai Kui and reading scenes; AD 376–396 copies the 太元 reign of Emperor Xiaowu onto offices, illness, deaths, attestations, and hints. The relative death sequence is the only supported chronology and must be kept. No owned check is approved.
Owned units s0244–s0266 give no birth or death years for p084–p088. The only numeric age is 年數歲 for Wang Xianzhi (p082) at the chupu scene, which is an age-at-event and not a birth year. Huan Xuan’s 太尉 court assembly (s0245–s0247) is Huan Xuan’s and Wang Zhenzhi’s own event: Jin Andi 元興元年三月 he 自稱太尉, and Eastern Jin 元興元年 (ruler 晉安帝, not the Han or Wu 元興 eras) converts as AD 402; month 3 begins 18 April 402, so the 壬申 appointment stays AD 402 in Julian and proleptic Gregorian. That supports claim-645/684/685/712 and the p084–p085 hints. The visit 嘗與兄徽之、操之俱詣謝安 has no source year; AD 360–396 is an invented career/Taiyuan-end window, and 396 postdates Xie An’s death in 太元十年 (AD 385). 遠慚荀奉倩 / 近愧劉真長 are Xianzhi’s childhood comparisons, not Xun Can’s or Liu Tan’s own events; AD 240–249 and 330–347 treat later reception as living activity (240–249 also mismatches 荀粲傳 太和初, death at 29). No birth/death was omitted from these units because the Chinese does not state them.
Owned units s0267–s0288 date two calendrical settings in the Chinese: 太元中 for the Jiankang Taiji Hall plaque episode (Xie An asking Wang Xianzhi) and 魏時 for the Lingyun Hall scaffold anecdote about Wei Zhongjiang. Those era/dynasty labels convert, at year precision, to Eastern Jin Xiaowu Taiyuan AD 376–396 and Cao Wei AD 220–265; the year-only endpoints are conventional reign-year labels, not day-level Gregorian event dates (Taiyuan 21/XII and Xianxi 2/XII each run into the next Western January). Claim-675 correctly keeps 七八歲時 as an age and does not invent a birth year. The remaining closed Western intervals are not in the Chinese: 七八歲時學書 is an age, not 永和/升平 or AD 345–361; 桓溫嘗使書扇 is an undated 嘗; 以選尚新安公主 and the Wu-commandery garden visit are likewise undated, and both were given the unrelated sourceDate 嘗與兄徽之、操之俱詣謝安 plus an invented AD 360–396 window. Context claim-690 uses that same unsupported visit window and is not accepted as Xie An life chronology. No owned unit states a birth or death for p089–p094.
Owned Taiyuan appointments for Wang Xianzhi (p082) convert 太元中 as conventional AD 376-396, and the Xie An death / honors cluster converts 及安薨 and 加安殊禮 to AD 385 from the Xiaowu annals (太元十年八月丁酉). Xiaowu's 陛下踐阼 is not AD 373: Jinshu 孝武帝紀 dates the accession to 咸安二年秋七月己未 (AD 372); 寧康元年 is only 改元. Empress Anxi's 立 is not AD 396: that year is her 太子妃 appointment, while 安帝紀 dates 立皇后王氏 to 隆安元年二月戊午 (AD 397), so the posthumous 以後父追贈 suite and claim-798 are later reception dated a year too early and must not feed Xianzhi's life dates. 先帝 as Jianwen's 咸安 reign (371-372) and the legendary 箕皓 comparanda are supported. Invented floruits are rejected: 郗曇 340-361, the first wife's 360-386 divorce span, the unnamed brother's 344-386 copy of Xianzhi's life, 靜之嗣 as exact 386 plus 位至義興太守 386-420 (a dynasty window), and 桓玄 398-404. p082's hint that he died inside the Taiyuan office era contradicts the same chapter's 未幾 / 俄而 sequel after 385. Year-only era labels were checked against Jinshu annals and era tables; no month/day Western dates were certified, and Academia Sinica's pre-1582 Julian default does not move these year-labels.
Chapter 80's Xu Mai appendix supplies one explicit calendar date, 永和二年, which belongs to Xu Mai's move into the Lin'an western hills and, by 乃, to his immediate rename; that 永和 is Eastern Jin Emperor Mu's era, whose conventional second year is AD 346, and the year-only label is not a month-day Gregorian instant. The review rejects the imported closed intervals AD 310-324 / 320-324 (Guo Pu visit), AD 317-340 (Bao Jing), AD 320-346 (parents still alive), BC 32-7 and BC 140-87 (Chen Anshi and Mao Jiwei), and AD 189-220 (漢末 / Zuo Ci), none of which are in the Chinese. 父母既終 cannot be AD 346: the deaths precede 遣婦, 遍游名山, and 餌術涉三年, so 346 is Xu Mai's later move, not the parents' death year; Wang Xizhi's repeated visits and the wife's farewell letter are after that move (onOrAfter 346), not year-locked events, while 未弱冠 is a correctly preserved age and 莫測所終 is an explicit non-death.
Owned units s0322–s0344 are the chapter-end calligraphy 贊. No owned sentence names a birth, death, age, ruler, reign, era, month, or day. The Chinese never writes 東漢後期, 曹魏, 東晉, or 南朝梁; those parenthetical sourceDate labels are extractor glosses. 伯英臨池 and 師宜懸帳 are recalled as vanished marvels (無復餘蹤 / 罕有遺跡). 鐘擅美一時 and 子雲近出 mark relative reputation, not calendar endpoints. 王逸少 is praised as the unique master, and 獻之 is judged against his father, still without years. 臥王濛於紙中 and 坐徐偃於筆下 are metaphors inside the critique of 子雲, not events those two men performed. Every dated attestation copies a traditional lifespan (168–192, 168–189, 151–230, 303–361, 344–386, 487–549, 309–347) and treats that span as an activity window. Endpoints have no owner-event justification in the passage: a window must state uncertainty about one event, not years of a life or a dynasty, and later reception must not feed life dates or active hints. The 贊 itself is also undated, so the reception cannot be given a Western year from these units. Active hints merely repeat the same unsupported spans, including legendary antiquity for 徐偃. Person records are therefore incoherent with the sealed evidence. The supplied sourceUrl returned 404; this review uses only the sealed unit texts. No conversion or competing source-date reading arises, because the Chinese supplies no date to convert.

itemChecks.event: Wang Xizhi was thirteen sui when he called on Zhou Yi.
itemChecks.reason: The chapter states 年十三 for Wang Xizhi himself and the claim keeps sui reckoning without converting the inclusive age into a birth year. Owner is p001; this is an age attestation, not a Western life date.

evidence.quote: 年十三，嘗謁周顗，顗察而異之。

itemChecks.event: Yu Liang died after composing a deathbed memorial that praised Wang Xizhi.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p013. 亮臨薨 in this chapter is Yu Liang’s own dying moment; Jinshu 成帝紀 and 庾亮傳 date that death to 咸康六年正月庚子. Conventional Chengdi 咸康六年 is AD 340. The death falls in lunar month 1, so the Western year is 340 in both Julian and proleptic Gregorian; Academia Sinica’s pre-1582 Julian default does not move the year near this New Year. Year precision is appropriate because the chapter itself has no month/day.

evidence.quote: 亮臨薨，上疏稱羲之清貴有鑒裁。

itemChecks.event: Wang Xizhi, at thirteen sui, visited Zhou Yi and first became known after the ox-heart roast.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p001. The source gives 年十三 but no reign year. AD 316–322 invents both a start (Eastern Jin founding or a reconstructed birth such as 303+13) and a closed career window. Zhou Yi’s 永昌元年 death supplies only an onOrBefore 322 bound; 幼 then 年十三 forbids treating the visit as a 316–322 activity span, and sui age must not be turned into a precise birth year.

evidence.quote: 年十三，嘗謁周顗，顗察而異之。
顗先割啖羲之，於是始知名。

itemChecks.event: As a boy Wang Xizhi was tongue-tied and not thought extraordinary.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p001. 幼 is a life-stage before 年十三, with no year. Dating it AD 317–322 copies Zhou Yi’s last Eastern Jin years and makes childhood simultaneous with the age-thirteen visit. The window describes dynasty-period activity, not uncertainty about one undated boyhood remark.

evidence.quote: 羲之幼訥於言，人未之奇。

itemChecks.event: After growing up, Wang Xizhi was valued by his uncles and later entered office under Yu Liang.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p001. 及長 is a life-stage, not a dated event. AD 324–340 joins Wang Dun’s 太寧二年 death to Yu Liang’s 咸康六年 death and treats early adulthood as activity throughout those years. s0009–s0010 have no year; s0019 belongs to the separate 征西 recruitment.

evidence.quote: 及長，辯贍，以骨鯁稱，尤善隸書
深為從伯敦、導所器重。
起家秘書郎，征西將軍庾亮請為參軍，累遷長史。

itemChecks.event: Wang Xizhi was commended in Yu Liang’s deathbed memorial.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p001. The commendation is Xizhi’s own event, dated by Yu Liang’s dying 上疏, not by later reception. 咸康六年正月庚子 is AD 340 at year precision; lunar month 1 does not cross the Western New Year.

evidence.quote: 亮臨薨，上疏稱羲之清貴有鑒裁。

itemChecks.event: Wang Dao is identified as Minister of Education in Wang Xizhi’s genealogy.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p002. 司徒導之從子也 is kinship identification, not a dated tenure. The 317–339 interval is Eastern Jin activity until Wang Dao’s 咸康五年 death. Mingdi annals first make him 司徒 in 太寧元年 (323); Chengdi annals move him from 司徒 to 太傅/丞相 in 咸康四年. Do not invent a second endpoint from a title label.

evidence.quote: 王羲之，字逸少，司徒導之從子也。
時太尉郗鑒使門生求女婿于導

itemChecks.event: Wang Zheng is recorded as having served as a Gentleman of the Masters of Writing.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p003. 祖正，尚書郎 names an office with no reign, month, or event. AD 265–316 is the entire Western Jin and therefore activity throughout a dynasty, not uncertainty about one service date. The date is unresolved in this chapter.

evidence.quote: 祖正，尚書郎。

itemChecks.event: Wang Kuang first proposed Sima Rui’s plan to cross the Yangzi.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p004. 曠首創其議 is Kuang’s own advice at the crossing. 元帝 is a later title for Sima Rui; the dated event is the 過江, not his later emperorship. 懷帝紀 永嘉元年秋七月己未 orders the 琅邪王 to 鎮建鄴; 元帝紀 says 永嘉初…始鎮建鄴. Conventional 永嘉元年 is AD 307. Year precision matches a reign-year label; the July appointment does not require a day-level Gregorian conversion.

evidence.quote: 元帝之過江也，曠首創其議。

itemChecks.event: Wang Kuang held office as Administrator of Huainan.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p004. 父曠，淮南太守 is an undated title. The 307 start is borrowed from the next sentence’s crossing; the 317 end is Eastern Jin founding and is invented. A closed 307–317 window turns one office label into activity across a decade. 懷帝紀 永嘉三年 still has 淮南內史王曠 fighting in the north, which contradicts treating Huainan as a 307–317 southern career and still supplies no 317 endpoint.

evidence.quote: 父曠，淮南太守。

itemChecks.event: Sima Rui, later Emperor Yuan, crossed the Yangzi to garrison Jianye.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p005. 元帝之過江也 is his own crossing under a retrospective imperial title. 永嘉元年七月己未 / 永嘉初 始鎮建鄴 convert to AD 307 at year precision. This is not a reception date and is not his 317–323 reign.

findings.problem: s0057 恐勝廣之憂 is Wang Xizhi’s present-tense fear of a Qin-style revolt. It does not date Chen Sheng’s or Wu Guang’s rising, death, or age. findings.action: Keep the mention. Recast claim-174 and claim-175 as retrospective-reference (or attestation with receptionType retrospective) whose date is the Hao-letter present, sharing the 353–354 letter window or remaining unresolved with a reason that Jin Shu 80 gives no Sheng-Guang year. Remove westernYear BC 209. Clear hints-p019 and hints-p020 of BC 209; do not invent a life year or delete the persons.

findings.problem: s0074’s 今/當今 dates one Kuaiji letter naming Yin Hao and Xun Xian; the closed AD 353–354 interval drops Yonghe 8 (AD 352) when both were already in the northern deployment and treats Yonghe 10 (AD 354, Hao’s dismissal) as a safe end, turning a single present into two-year activity.
findings.action: Keep the rows as contemporary attestations of Hao and Xun Xian in the recall. Replace westernInterval 353–354 with unresolved:true and a reason that the letter has no reign year, or with westernBounds onOrAfter AD 352 and onOrBefore AD 354 that preserve the Yonghe 8 / 9 / early-10 competing placements. Do not invent a second exact year. Synchronize hints-p025 and hints-p026 to that repaired uncertainty; do not leave AD 353–354 as active hints.

findings.problem: 伍員之憂不獨在昔 is Wang Xizhi’s retrospective exemplum, yet claim-204 and the p027 hint date Wu Zixu’s own life to BC 522–484 with certainty explicit.
findings.action: Reclassify the Wu Zixu mention as retrospective-reference or receptionType retrospective, dated with the Kuaiji letter (same unresolved/bounded present as claims 195/199), not with Spring-and-Autumn years. Remove BC 522–484 from the attestation and from active hints. Do not add a birth or death from Zuozhuan Zhao 20 / Ai 11; those are other events and are not what s0081 attests.

findings.problem: 蹈東海 in s0087 is a proverbial reception of Lu Zhonglian’s Handan speech, yet the claim assigns explicit BC 284–260 life years and the hint repeats them.
findings.action: Keep the allusion as retrospective reception at the letter’s present. Delete BC 284–260 from the claim and from hints-p030. Do not substitute Changping/Handan years (BC 260/258) as Lu’s life dates in this chapter.

findings.problem: 時東土饑荒 names Wang Xizhi’s granary relief without a year; AD 353–355 is a tenure-like span, not a justified uncertainty window for that famine.
findings.action: Keep subject/predicate (Wang Xizhi’s relief/attestation). Mark the source date 時 unresolved, or use westernBounds only where the same biography actually bounds Kuaiji office (onOrBefore the Yonghe 11/III resignation). Do not keep start-year 353 merely because Lan-ting is Yonghe 9.

findings.problem: Dating Xie An as 尚書僕射 correspondent in AD 353–355 contradicts this chapter’s 謝安未仕時亦居焉 and Jinshu 79; Yonghe puye belongs to Xie Shang in Jinshu 8.
findings.action: Do not assign AD 353–355 as Xie An’s activity. Leave names untouched. Treat the puye heading as anachronistic or contested labeling: if Xie An remains the subject, record retrospective/anachronistic title and drop the Yonghe living interval; do not silently retitle the addressee. The letter body (漕運, 此一郡) stays a Kuaiji-period administrative text for Wang Xizhi, not an active date for Xie An.

findings.problem: Xie An’s 未仕時 residence/status is given an invented AD 345–360 window labeled explicit, while the active hint instead uses unsupported AD 353–355 and clashes with a context letter addressing him as 尚書僕射.
findings.action: Keep the Kuaiji residence and not-yet-in-office facts. Replace the Western interval with unresolved:true and a reason that 未仕時 is not a convertible year; do not invent 345 or 360. Clear the AD 353–355 hint. Do not use the 尚書僕射 letter as an active-life date.

findings.problem: Yonghe 9 / AD 353 is transferred from Wang Xizhi’s Lanting preface onto 孫綽、李充、許詢、支遁, whom s0113 names only as undated eastern peers.
findings.action: Remove 永和九年 and AD 353 from their attestation rows and hints. Keep the undated 築室東土，與羲之同好 association, or mark any date unresolved. Do not import later participant lists to manufacture their presence year.

findings.problem: p035 is given Yonghe 9 from preface sentences that neither name 羲之 nor contain the year, duplicating p028’s Lanting date; the AD 353 hint follows that row.
findings.action: Remove or re-evidence claim-297 so p035 is not dated from s0119–s0129. Synchronize hints to supported p035 events (context Yonghe 11 / AD 355 resignation). Do not treat p028’s gathering year as this ID’s life date.

findings.problem: sourceDate 東晉永和前後 and the AD 353–355 window on s0130/s0131/s0149/s0152 are not in the Chinese; undated anecdotes are closed as a Yonghe activity span.
findings.action: Delete the fabricated sourceDate and year window. Leave those anecdotes undated or unresolved and preserve only narrative sequence after the preface, without inventing endpoints.

findings.problem: 齊彭殤 is stored as Peng Zu’s legendary-antiquity attestation and active hint rather than as a retrospective allusion in the preface.
findings.action: Reclassify the mention as retrospective-reference or receptionType retrospective. Remove legendary antiquity as a life/activity date and clear the matching hint. Do not assign Peng Zu a living year from this chapter.

findings.problem: The later 金穀詩序 / 石崇 comparison is dated AD 296–300 as Pan Yue’s and Shi Chong’s living attestation; those years are not in s0130.
findings.action: Keep the comparison as retrospective reception of Pan Yue’s preface and of Shi Chong. Remove 296–300 and the matching hints. Do not invent a Jingu year or use the reception as a life date.

findings.problem: The widow’s undated goose story is given fabricated 東晉永和前後 / AD 353–355 chronology and an active hint.
findings.action: Remove the invented window and hint. Mark the anecdote unresolved or leave it undated; do not borrow Wang Xizhi’s Yonghe years as her life dates.

findings.problem: Four undated 嘗 anecdotes (Daoist geese, disciple’s table, father’s scraping, Mount Ji fans) were given a fabricated source label 東晉永和前後 and a closed AD 353–355 window taken from other Yonghe markers, then copied into active hints.
findings.action: Remove the invented interval and sourceDate text. Leave each encounter unresolved, or use only a one-sided bound that does not invent a second year. Clear the matching AD 353–355 hints.

findings.problem: Zhong Yao is dated as if active in Cao Wei AD 200–230, but the chapter only has Wang Xizhi comparing his writing to 鐘繇.
findings.action: Reclassify the mention as retrospective reception (retrospective-reference or receptionType retrospective). Delete the Cao Wei life interval and the AD 200–230 hint. Do not use the reception as a life date.

findings.problem: Zhang Zhi is dated to late Han AD 168–192 from Wang Xizhi’s ranking/pond story and Yu Yi’s later Boying recollection.
findings.action: Keep those later references as retrospective reception of Zhang Zhi. Remove 東漢末 / 168–192 and the AD 168–192 hint. Do not convert Yu Yi’s 過江 memory into Zhang Zhi’s life years.

findings.problem: Yu Yi’s undated peer comparison and letter were boxed into an Eastern Jin career window AD 327–345, hiding the earlier undated 過江 loss.
findings.action: Drop 327–345 and the matching hint. Keep the comparison and letter without invented years. If the 過江 recollection is kept, mark it unresolved rather than assigning a guessed crossing year.

findings.problem: Xi Yin is only named in Wang Xizhi’s later comparison, yet is given AD 340–356 as living activity.
findings.action: Remove the invented window and hint. Treat 郗愔 as an undated mention or as retrospective reception, not as a dated career.

findings.problem: Yu Liang’s receipt of an undated 章草 reply was dated AD 317–340, a dynasty-career span rather than this letter.
findings.action: Remove 317–340 and the hint. Leave the letter’s date unresolved. Do not turn conventional Eastern Jin bounds into a Gregorian event interval.

findings.problem: Wang Shu’s attestation and active hint use 永和十一年/AD 355, which in this biography dates Wang Xizhi’s oath. The cited units have no year; the Mu-emperor annals date Shu’s Yang appointment to 永和十年 (conventional AD 354). The chapter’s mourning–累年–appointment–audit sequence is flattened.
findings.action: Detach 永和十一年/355 from Wang Shu. If the Yang appointment is dated, use the annals’ 永和十年 and the conventional AD 354 year-label, without pretending that label is a month-day Gregorian date. Keep rivalry, mourning, appointment, and audit as separate sequenced events. Replace the AD 355 hint accordingly. Context claim-387 needs the same year correction.

findings.problem: 母喪 attests the mother’s death, but both the death and a living attestation were closed at AD 353–355, and that window was reused as an activity hint. 累年 before the Yonghe 10 appointment makes a death still open through 355 untenable.
findings.action: Keep the death claim. Strip the 353–355 dateContext; set the death unresolved or use a one-sided bound before the Kuaiji succession / before the Yang appointment. Remove the living attestation years and the AD 353–355 hint. Do not treat the death as activity.

findings.problem: 羲之既去官 and Xie An's 嘗謂 are one-sided after the Yonghe 11.3.9 resignation, but the extraction turned that bound into an exact AD 355 year for Xizhi's later roaming, Xu Mai's itinerary, and Xie An's middle-age remark, then copied 355 into active hints.
findings.action: On claim-299, claim-414, and claim-418, replace the exact westernYear 355 with an after/onOrAfter bound from the oath or mark the later anecdotes unresolved; strip AD 355 from hints-p057 and hints-p058. Preserve Xie An's 中年 as age reckoning. Do not invent an end year.

findings.problem: Wang Shu's Yang appointment is undated in s0156; 永和十一年/AD 355 was transferred from Xizhi's later oath and contradicts 晉書穆帝紀 永和十年二月.
findings.action: Retie claim-387 to 永和十年 (AD 354) from 穆帝紀 二月己丑 以前會稽內史王述爲揚州刺史, or, if confined to this chapter, drop the invented exact year and keep only a bound before the Yonghe 11.3.9 oath. Certainty cannot remain explicit-from-s0156.

findings.problem: Tan is only named in Xizhi's comparison and has no dated personal event, yet he was given an explicit Yonghe 11 / AD 355 attestation and active hint.
findings.action: Remove the transferred 永和十一年/355 date from claim-398 or recast the row as an undated mention; clear hints-p051. Do not create a Tan life year from 不及坦之.

findings.problem: 夙遭閔凶 and 母兄鞠育 were turned into an AD 317–345 living window for father, mother, and elder brother. That span is an Eastern-Jin dynasty bracket, not uncertainty about one event, and it treats the later tomb rite as parental activity.
findings.action: Delete the 317–345 interval from claim-401, claim-405, and claim-408 and from the three hints. Keep claim-402's undated early-death manner. Do not convert youth-rearing into exact years.

findings.problem: 于父母墓前 shows the mother already dead by Yonghe 11.3.9, after she had reared Xizhi, but no death claim was extracted.
findings.action: Add a death for p053 with a one-sided bound onOrBefore the oath day (and after the father's earlier 夙 death). Do not use the tomb rite as her living activity or as a precise death year.

findings.problem: 老氏 and 周任 are retrospective citations in Xizhi's AD 355 oath, but they were given BC 571–479 and BC 1046–771 life windows and matching active hints.
findings.action: Remove those Western intervals and hints. Keep the names as retrospective reception on the oath (receptionType retrospective or kind retrospective-reference). Do not add encyclopedia life dates or a posthumous subtype.

findings.problem: 時劉惔為丹陽尹 is dated as a closed AD 345–349 tenure. The chapter has no year. 建康實錄 dates the appointment and this lodging anecdote to 永和三年十二月, while 資治通鑑 in 永和元年 both uses the title 丹楊尹 and sends Liu Tan to 沔中. AD 345 is therefore not a justified start for the Jiankang gathering. The 349 end is an external death terminus (劉真長死 while 褚裒 still lived; 褚裒 died 永和五年十二月), not an explicit source end.
findings.action: Replace the 345–349 interval on the Danyang gathering/office/place claims and the p059–p061 hints with bounds that preserve competing witnesses: onOrAfter the 永和三年十二月 appointment (conventional AD 347; note the lunar twelfth month may fall in AD 348 and was not converter-normalized day by day) against the possibly proleptic 永和元年 title, and onOrBefore 349 as a death terminus only. Do not invent a second exact year or keep 345 as the office start.

findings.problem: Wang’s leisure, eastern return, and the planned tour with Xie An are given a closed AD 355–361 window. AD 355 follows the chapter vow 永和十一年, but AD 361 is not in 年五十九卒 and is a chosen death year (書斷 昇平五年卒 among competing reconstructions). Death is also used as an active hint. 頃東游還 and 比當與安石東遊山海 are letter-moment events, not six-year activity.
findings.action: Keep the 355 start as onOrAfter the vow. Remove the exact 361 leisure/tour endpoint; leave the death year unresolved or as competing later witnesses, not as source-explicit. Date the eastern return and Xie An plan by the first letter (after the vow, before the 358 Yuzhou letter). Drop death from p061 active hints; do not convert 五十九 into a birth year.

findings.problem: 萬後為豫州都督 and the second letter are given exact AD 359. 晉書·穆帝紀 and 資治通鑑 date the appointment to 升平二年八月 (AD 358) and place Wang’s cautionary letter there. The defeat is 升平三年 (AD 359). The hint ‘AD 359 Yuzhou commander and defeat’ merges those events.
findings.action: Date the appointment, posting, and second letter to conventional AD 358 (升平二年). Keep AD 359 only for the defeat (context claim-574). Split the p066 hint so commander and defeat are not one 359 event. 吏部郎 355–358 may remain as letter uncertainty.

findings.problem: 陸賈、班嗣、楊王孫 are named only as models Wang hopes to emulate. The claims assign explicit Han floruits (BC 202–180, BC 32–AD 5, BC 141–87) that are not in this chapter and are reign/dynasty slices (漢書 孝武時人也 for Yang Wangsun). Active hints repeat those slices as if they were living events.
findings.action: Do not delete the names. Reclassify each as retrospective reception of Wang’s letter (kind retrospective-reference, or receptionType retrospective on the honor/work claim), dated to the letter, with these men as subjects of later citation. Remove the imported Western intervals from attestations and from p068–p070 active hints. Do not add new external biographies.

findings.problem: s0202–s0203 give Wang Xizhi’s death at 59 sui, a same-sentence 贈金紫光祿大夫, and the sons’ refusal, with no reign year. AD 361 is imported (真誥 升平五年 is one later witness among others) and then reused as a life/honor year.
findings.action: Keep age 59 sui at death. Remove westernYear AD 361 from the death, the gift, and the sons’ refusal. Leave those events unresolved as to year, or record competing witnesses without choosing one. Keep the gift and refusal as posthumous honor/reception sequenced after death, not as living activity or active hints.

findings.problem: Ningzhi’s name heading and undated 仕歷 offices were given a 355–399 activity window. 355 is not his event; 399 is his death year from Sun En, not the start or span of every office.

findings.problem: 玄之早卒 was given an invented AD 340–361 death window and an active hint, using the father’s putative dates rather than Xuanzhi’s own undated death.
findings.action: Keep the death as died-young / 早卒 with unresolved:true and a reason that the source has no year. Remove both Western endpoints and the 340–361 hint. Do not infer a birth year.

findings.problem: 車騎桓沖 and Huizhi’s 騎兵參軍 were dated 373–384. In 寧康元年 Chong was 中軍將軍; 車騎 begins 甯康三年 (375) in the biography or 太元元年 (376) in the annals, and he still held 車騎 at death in 太元九年 (384).
findings.action: Replace the 373 start. For Chong’s 車騎 office use onOrAfter 375 with the 376 annal as a competing first year, and onOrBefore 384 from the death still as 車騎. For Huizhi’s cavalry post use the same title-based bounds as uncertainty, not a full-tenure activity span. Keep Huizhi’s 363–373 Wen adviser hint; delete 373–384 from p074 and p076 hints.

findings.problem: 左思《招隱詩》, 井丹, and 長卿 are later quotations or literary comparisons in Wang Huizhi's anecdotes, not dated events of Zuo Si, Jing Dan, or Sima Xiangru. The closed spans AD 270–300, AD 58–88, and BC 179–117 are absent from the Chinese and treat reception as living activity.
findings.action: Reclassify each as retrospective-reference (or receptionType retrospective on a narrower honor/work claim) without Western life years; set unresolved:true with a reason that the chapter gives no year; delete the three active-date hints. Do not import external lifespans to clear the row.

findings.problem: 逵時在剡 supports Dai Kui's residence/visit but not AD 360–395. The interval invents both endpoints and reads as activity across decades.
findings.action: Keep the Shan residence and the night visit as undated or unresolved source dates; remove westernInterval 360–395 from claim-491 and claim-533 and drop hints-p078. Do not fabricate a death or visit year from another biography.

findings.problem: The joint reading 與弟獻之共讀《高士傳贊》 is Xianzhi's own event but has no year. AD 370–386 invents both ends. p079 is isolated from the chapter's 獻之卒 notice, which is filed under p082.
findings.action: Keep the reading without a Western interval; remove hints-p079. Do not borrow p082 death years as p079 activity or merge identities in this repair.

findings.problem: One AD 376–396 window—the conventional 太元 1–21 label of 東晉孝武帝—is applied to Huizhi's Palace Attendant tenure and resignation, the joint illness, Xianzhi's death, Huizhi's death a month later, and both attestations. Owned units s0222–s0243 contain no era name. Same-chapter 太元中 dates the Taiji Hall plaque; 俄而卒於官 follows 及安薨. A reign-length band is not event uncertainty, and office claims wrongly use 未幾，獻之卒……月餘亦卒 as their sourceDate.
findings.action: Strip AD 376–396 from every listed claim. Keep 後為黃門侍郎, 棄官東歸, 俱病篤, 獻之卒, and 月餘亦卒 as explicit events with unresolved Western dates (or, if converting 及安薨, one-sided bounds only—never a second invented end). Point office dateContext at 後為黃門侍郎，棄官東歸. Preserve Xianzhi died first and Huizhi a little over a month later. Rewrite hints-p083 to that relative death only, not a Taiyuan career span.

findings.problem: The Xie An visit is undated (嘗). AD 360–396 is an invented era/career window, and 396 is after Xie An’s death in 太元十年 (AD 385). It describes activity through a period, not uncertainty about one visit.
findings.action: Drop both invented endpoints. Keep the visit as the brothers’ and Xie An’s own event with unresolved:true and a reason that 嘗 names no year; if a bound is added, use only a one-sided onOrBefore from the 太元十年 death (AD 385), not a new start year. Clear the 360–396 active hint for p086.

findings.problem: 遠慚荀奉倩 is Xianzhi’s later comparison, not Xun Can’s own event. AD 240–249 treats reception as living activity, is not in the chapter, and conflicts with 荀粲傳 太和初 / death at 29.
findings.action: Reclassify as retrospective-reference or receptionType retrospective on the childhood remark; remove the 240–249 attestation interval and the matching active-date hint. Do not invent a birth or death year from this mention.

findings.problem: 近愧劉真長 is the same Xianzhi recollection, not Liu Tan’s own event. AD 330–347 is an invented Eastern Jin activity window used as attestation and as an active hint.
findings.action: Reclassify as retrospective reception of Xianzhi’s remark; remove 330–347 from the attestation and from p088 active-date hints. Do not convert the comparison into Liu Tan life dates.

findings.problem: s0267 dates the brush episode only by 七八歲時. AD 345–361 is not in the Chinese; it converts an age (or Xizhi’s Mu-era reputation) into a closed Western interval and then repeats that interval as Xizhi’s active hint.
findings.action: Drop the Western interval on claim-681 and claim-691. Keep claim-675 as an age-only row. Set those attestations unresolved:true with a reason that 七八歲時 is an age, not a reign year, or remove the invented dates. Clear the AD 345–361 hint for p090. Do not infer a birth year from inclusive sui.

findings.problem: 桓溫嘗使書扇 has no era or year. AD 345–373 is Huan Wen’s external career, not uncertainty attested in s0269.
findings.action: Remove the closed 345–373 interval and the matching hint. Mark the fan episode unresolved:true, or leave it as an undated attestation. Do not replace 嘗 with a career-long window.

findings.problem: The princess’s event is 以選尚新安公主, which is undated. The row’s sourceDate 嘗與兄徽之、操之俱詣謝安 is another person’s visit, and AD 360–396 is invented.
findings.action: Replace the sourceDate with the marriage sentence or strip the date fields; set unresolved:true. Remove the AD 360–396 marriage hint. Do not reuse the Xie An visit as her chronology.

findings.problem: The Wu-commandery garden scene is undated 嘗經吳郡. The sourceDate is the unrelated Xie An visit, and AD 360–396 is invented.
findings.action: Remove the mismatched sourceDate and the 360–396 interval and hint. Mark Gu’s garden episode unresolved:true. Do not date it from Xianzhi’s career.

findings.problem: 陛下踐阼 is Xiaowu's accession in 咸安二年秋七月己未 (conventional AD 372). The extraction uses exact AD 373, which is 寧康元年改元, and then starts Xie An's active hint at that false year.
findings.action: Replace the accession westernYear with AD 372 on claim-803, claim-907, and the Xie An contextual attestation claim-795. Synchronize hints-p101 and the start of hints-p095 to 372. Do not keep 373 as a second endpoint or treat 寧康 as the accession date.

findings.problem: 安僖皇后立 is the empress's installation. 安帝紀 dates 立皇后王氏 to 隆安元年二月戊午 (AD 397). 太元二十一年 / AD 396 is when she was made heir-consort. Claim-798 also treats that later reception as Xianzhi's living attestation after 俄而卒於官.
findings.action: Redate claim-807 and the posthumous honors claim-842 through claim-846 to AD 397 as retrospective reception on 安僖皇后立. Reclassify or replace claim-798 so 396/397 is the reception date, not a life attestation, and keep it off p096 active hints. Set hints-p104 to 397. Do not discard the honors.

findings.problem: 郗曇 is an undated kinship identification. AD 340-361 is not in the chapter.
findings.action: Remove the 340-361 interval from claim-805 and hints-p102, or mark the attestation unresolved with a reason that the chapter gives no date. Do not import a full Xi Tan biography.

findings.problem: 與郗家離婚 is recalled at Xianzhi's last illness; the divorce year is not stated. AD 360-386 is a guessed life span.
findings.action: Drop 360-386. If a date is kept, date only the deathbed recollection with the 385-386 illness/death sequel, and leave the divorce itself unresolved.

findings.problem: 兄 in 以兄子靜之嗣 has no own dated event. AD 344-386 copies Xianzhi's conventional life onto the brother.
findings.action: Remove the invented endpoints and the active hint years. Do not infer a birth year from anyone's traditional inclusive age.

findings.problem: 靜之嗣 and 位至義興太守 are undated. Exact 386 is false precision; 386-420 is activity through the end of Eastern Jin.
findings.action: Mark both claims unresolved, or use only a one-sided bound after Xianzhi's death (onOrAfter 385/386) without inventing 420. Clear the matching hints.

findings.problem: 桓玄雅愛其父子書 is undated later reception. AD 398-404 is Huan Xuan's political floruit, not this passage.
findings.action: Remove the 398-404 window and the active hint. Keep the appreciation as an undated or retrospective event; do not fabricate a career interval.

findings.problem: p082's death is fed into the Taiyuan office window AD 376-396, against the same chapter's 未幾 / 俄而 sequel after Xie An's AD 385 death.
findings.action: Keep the 376-396 hint only for the 太元中 / 尋除 offices. Date illness and death from 及安薨 plus 未幾遇疾 / 俄而卒於官 (385-386), in line with p096, and do not use the posthumous 396/397 honors as life dates.

findings.problem: 永和二年 dates Xu Mai's Lin'an move, not Wang Xizhi's repeated visits; AD 346 as Xizhi's exact active year turns a one-sided after-the-move fact into a closed year.
findings.action: Remove or rewrite the Xizhi attestation/hint so he is not year-locked to 346. If a Western bound is kept, use onOrAfter AD 346 for the visits and do not invent an end year. Leave s0317-s0319 as undated personal events.

findings.problem: 未弱冠，嘗造郭璞 has no calendar year, yet the extraction assigns disagreeing closed windows AD 310-324 (claims) and AD 320-324 (hints).
findings.action: Strip the invented Western intervals from the Guo Pu visit. Keep claim-904's age statement. Mark the visit unresolved or leave it undated; do not import Guo Pu's external lifespan to manufacture endpoints. On hints-p109 retain only the supported AD 346 Lin'an move.

findings.problem: 時南海太守鮑靚隱跡潛遁 is a narrative 'at that time', not AD 317-340.
findings.action: Remove the 317-340 window and the matching hint. Do not replace it with another dynasty-length career span. If a date is required, set unresolved:true with a reason that 時 has no year in this chapter.

findings.problem: 父母尚存 and 父母既終 are sequential and both precede 遍游名山, 餌術涉三年, and 永和二年; dating the deaths to AD 346 and the parents' survival as AD 320-346 contradicts that order and invents 320.

references.reason: Xu Song attaches the Xu Xun lodging to the 永和三年 appointment, the same scene as s0179.

references.title: 資治通鑑/卷097
references.quote: 丹楊尹劉惔每奇溫才
references.reason: Competing 永和元年 title that must be preserved against the 347 appointment rather than treated as a 345–349 tenure.

references.title: 資治通鑑/卷097
references.quote: 又以劉惔監沔中諸軍事，領義成太守
references.reason: Shows that in 永和元年 Liu Tan was sent to Mianzhong, so AD 345 is not a safe year for the Jiankang Yin household scene.

references.title: 資治通鑑/卷098
references.quote: 十二月，己酉，卒。
references.reason: Dates 褚裒’s death to 永和五年十二月 (conventional AD 349), the latest year he could hear of 劉真長死.

references.title: 世說新語·輕詆 9
references.quote: 言及劉真長死
references.reason: Shows Liu Tan was already dead when Chu Pou went south, supplying the onOrBefore 349 death bound.

references.title: 晉書/卷008
references.quote: 秋八月，安西將軍謝奕卒。壬申，以吳興太守謝萬爲西中郎將、持節、監司豫冀幷四州諸軍事、豫州刺史。
references.reason: Primary 升平二年 date for Xie Wan’s Yuzhou command, against the extracted AD 359 appointment.

references.title: 晉書/卷008
references.quote: 冬十月慕容儁寇東阿，遣西中郎將謝萬次下蔡，北中郎將郗曇次高平以擊之，王師敗績。
references.reason: Primary 升平三年 date for Xie Wan’s defeat, the event that was wrongly used to date the appointment.

references.title: 資治通鑑/卷100
references.quote: 又遺萬書曰：「以君邁往不屑之韻，而俯同群碎，誠難為意也。
references.reason: Places Wang Xizhi’s cautionary letter in 升平二年 with the appointment, not in 359.

references.title: 書斷/卷中
references.quote: 昇平五年卒，年五十九
references.reason: Later biographical witness for Wang Xizhi’s death in 升平五年; must be kept as a competing reading, not treated as Jinshu 80’s own year.

references.title: 漢書/卷067
references.quote: 楊王孫者，孝武時人也。
references.reason: Shows the imported BC 141–87 window is Wudi’s reign label, absent from Jinshu 80.

references.title: 漢書/卷043
references.quote: 陸賈，楚人也。以客從高祖定天下
references.reason: External Han source for Lu Jia’s Gaozu-era activity; not a date in the owned Jinshu units.

references.title: 漢書/卷100上
references.quote: 幼與從兄嗣共遊學，家有賜書
references.reason: Identifies Ban Si without the BC 32–AD 5 interval used in the extraction.

references.title: 資治通鑑·晉紀二十二
references.quote: 升平二年（戊午，公元三五八年）
references.reason: Conventional AD label for 升平二年 used to check the 358 vs 359 conversion. Year-only; no month/day Gregorian normalization required.

references.title: 晉書/卷008 穆帝紀 升平三年
references.quote: 冬十月慕容儁寇東阿，遣西中郎將謝萬次下蔡，北中郎將郗曇次高平以擊之，王師敗績。
references.reason: Primary annal that converts this chapter’s 果敗 to 升平三年冬十月, conventional AD 359.

references.title: 晉書/卷008 哀帝紀 興寧元年
references.quote: 五月，加征西大將軍桓溫侍中、大司馬、都督中外諸軍事、錄尚書事、假黃鉞。
references.reason: Primary annal for Huan Wen becoming 大司馬 in 興寧元年五月, conventional AD 363 (onOrAfter 363).

references.title: 晉書/卷009 孝武帝紀 寧康元年
references.quote: 秋七月己亥，使持節、侍中、都督中外諸軍事、丞相、錄尚書、大司馬、揚州牧、平北將軍、徐兗二州刺史、南郡公桓溫薨。
references.reason: Primary annal for Wen’s death still as 大司馬 in 寧康元年七月, conventional AD 373.

references.title: 晉書/卷009 孝武帝紀 寧康元年
references.quote: 以江州刺史桓沖爲中軍將軍、都督揚豫江三州諸軍事、揚州刺史，鎮姑孰。
references.reason: Shows Chong’s 373 succession title was 中軍將軍, so 車騎 cannot start in 373.

references.title: 晉書/卷009 孝武帝紀 太元元年
references.quote: 中軍將軍桓沖爲車騎將軍
references.reason: Annal witness that Chong became 車騎 in 太元元年 (AD 376), competing with the 甯康三年 biography date.

references.title: 晉書/卷009 孝武帝紀 太元九年
references.quote: 二月辛巳，使持節、都督荊江梁寧益交廣七州諸軍事、車騎將軍、荊州刺史桓沖卒。
references.reason: Primary annal that Chong still held 車騎 at death in 太元九年二月, conventional AD 384.

references.title: 晉書/卷010 安帝紀 隆安三年
references.quote: 十一月甲寅，妖賊孫恩陷會稽，內史王凝之死之
references.reason: Primary annal converting 孫恩之攻會稽 and 遂為孫所害 to 隆安三年十一月甲寅, conventional AD 399.

references.title: 晉書/卷074 桓沖傳
references.quote: 於是改授都督徐兗豫青揚五州之六郡軍事、車騎將軍、徐州刺史
references.reason: Biography witness that Chong received 車騎 in 甯康三年 (AD 375), not in 373.

references.title: 真誥/卷016 闡幽微第二
references.quote: 至升平五年辛酉歲亡，年五十九。
references.reason: External competing witness for Xizhi’s death year; it is not in Jinshu 80 and must not be treated as the unique conversion of 年五十九卒.

references.title: 中央研究院 兩千年中西曆轉換
references.quote: 在此之前的西曆稱為儒略(Julian)曆
references.reason: Documents the converter’s Julian default before 1582. The month/day annals used here (十月, 十一月, 五月, 七月, 二月) do not sit on a New Year seam that would change the AD year; year labels are also stated as proleptic Gregorian where a day is known.

references.title: 太元 (東晉)
references.quote: 太元（ 376年—396年）是東晋皇帝晋孝武帝司马曜的第二个年号，共计21年
references.reason: Confirms that AD 376–396 is the conventional 太元 1–21 label of Eastern Jin Emperor Xiaowu (司馬曜), not a date given in the owned Huizhi/Xianzhi death or office sentences. 太元二十一年 also runs into early AD 397, so the closed 376–396 year pair is already a reign label rather than a Gregorian event date.

references.title: 晉書 : 列傳第五十
references.quote: 太元中，新起太極殿
references.reason: Same-chapter witness that the only 太元 date near these lives is 太元中 for the Taiji Hall plaque, a different Xianzhi event from 後為黃門侍郎, 俱病篤, 獻之卒, or 月餘亦卒.

references.title: 晉書 : 列傳第五十
references.quote: 俄而卒於官
references.reason: Xianzhi's own biography sequences 俄而卒於官 after 及安薨, so even chapter-level context does not support dating that death (or Huizhi's death a month later) to the whole 太元 span 376–396.

references.title: 晋书/卷010 - 维基文库
references.quote: 玄俄又自称太尉、扬州牧，总百揆
references.reason: Primary 晉安帝紀 passage dating Huan Xuan’s self-appointment as 太尉 to 元興元年三月, the contextual year behind 桓玄為太尉.

references.title: 元兴 (东晋) - 维基百科
references.quote: 元兴（402年—404年）是東晋皇帝晋安帝司马德宗的第二个年号
references.reason: Calendar/era reference identifying 東晉 晉安帝 元興 (not Han or Wu 元興) as AD 402–404, so 元興元年 converts as AD 402.

references.title: 南北朝朔闰异同表
references.quote: 402 | 晋安帝元兴元年/大亨元年
references.reason: Month table placing 晋安帝元兴元年正月 at 18 February and 三月 at 18 April 402, so the 三月壬申 Taiwei appointment stays AD 402 (Julian-style 公历; proleptic Gregorian is the next day and the same year).

references.title: 晋书/卷009 - 维基文库
references.quote: 丁酉，使持节、侍中、中书监、大都督十五州诸军事、卫将军、太保谢安薨。
references.reason: Primary 孝武帝紀 witness, under 太元十年八月, that Xie An died then; AD 396 cannot bound a visit to him.

references.title: 南北朝朔闰异同表
references.quote: 385 | 晋孝武帝太元十年
references.reason: Converts 晉孝武帝 太元十年 as AD 385, the Western year of Xie An’s recorded death.

references.title: 荀粲传 - 维基文库
references.quote: 太和初，到京邑与傅嘏谈
references.reason: He Shao’s biography places Xun Can at the capital in 曹魏 明帝 太和初, not in 正始 (AD 240–249).

references.title: 荀粲传 - 维基文库
references.quote: 岁馀亦亡，时年二十九
references.reason: Same biography: Xun Can died at twenty-nine after his wife’s death, so a 240–249 activity window is not his lifespan even aside from this chapter’s retrospective use.

references.title: 太元 (东晋)
references.quote: 寧康四年（376年）正月三日，改元為太元元年。
references.reason: Primary calendar check for 太元中: Eastern Jin Xiaowu, 寧康四年正月改元太元元年, conventional AD 376 start of the era-year label.

references.title: 太元 (东晋)
references.quote: 太元二十二年（397年）正月一日，改元為隆安元年。
references.reason: Confirms Taiyuan ends when 隆安元年 begins in the first month of 397, so the conventional last Taiyuan year-label is AD 396 (太元二十一年), not a day-level span through every month.

references.title: 黄初
references.quote: 黃初元年——十月二十九日，魏王曹丕稱帝，建立魏國。
references.reason: Confirms Cao Wei begins in 黄初元年 tenth month under 文帝曹丕, the conventional AD 220 year-label used for 魏時.

references.title: 咸熙
references.quote: 咸熙二年十二月，曹奂被迫禅位于司马炎。曹魏灭亡，晋朝建立。
references.reason: Confirms 咸熙 is Cao Wei’s last era and that the abdication falls in 咸熙二年十二月, the conventional AD 265 year-label for the dynasty’s end (that twelfth month overlaps January 266).

references.title: 晉書/卷009 孝武帝紀
references.quote: 咸安二年秋七月己未，立為皇太子。是日，簡文帝崩，太子卽皇帝位。
references.reason: Primary annal for 陛下踐阼: Xiaowu acceded on the day Jianwen died in 咸安二年七月, not in 寧康元年.

references.title: 晉書/卷009 孝武帝紀
references.quote: 寧康元年春正月己丑朔，改元。
references.reason: Shows AD 373 is the Ningkang era-change, which must not be substituted for the 咸安二年 accession.

references.title: 晉書/卷009 孝武帝紀
references.quote: 丁酉，使持節、侍中、中書監、大都督十五州諸軍事、衛將軍、太保謝安薨。
references.reason: Primary annal, under 太元十年八月, for converting 及安薨 to conventional AD 385.

references.title: 太元 (东晋)
references.quote: 太元（ 376年—396年）是東晋皇帝晋孝武帝司马曜的第二个年号
references.reason: Calendar reference for mapping 太元中 and 太元十年 to conventional AD 376-396 / 385 year-labels (ruler Xiaowu, Eastern Jin).

references.title: 太元 (东晋)
references.quote: 太元二十二年（397年）正月一日，改元為隆安元年。
references.reason: Calendar reference that 隆安元年, the year of 立皇后王氏, is conventional AD 397, not 396.

references.title: 咸安 (年号)
references.quote: 咸安（ 371年十一月—372年）是東晋皇帝晉简文帝司馬昱的年号
references.reason: Calendar reference for Jianwen's 咸安 reign-labels used for 先帝 and for converting 咸安二年七月 to AD 372.

references.title: 晉書/卷010 安帝紀
references.quote: 戊午，立皇后王氏。
references.reason: Primary annal, under 隆安元年二月, for 安僖皇后立. This is the empress installation, distinct from the 太元二十一年 heir-consort appointment.

references.title: 晉書/卷032 安僖王皇后傳
references.quote: 后以太元二十一年納為太子妃。及安帝即位，立為皇后。
references.reason: Explains the competing 396 reading: Taiyuan 21 is 納為太子妃; 立為皇后 is a later clause, which the annals date to Long'an 1.

references.title: 永和 (东晋)
references.quote: 永和（345年—356年）是东晋皇帝晉穆帝司馬聃的第一个年号，共计12年。
references.reason: Identifies this 永和 as Eastern Jin Emperor Mu Sima Dan's first era, 345-356, so 永和二年 is the conventional AD 346 year-label rather than Han or later homonymous 永和. The same page's year table lists 永和二年 丙午 as 346, with that lunar year falling inside Western 346, so the year-only conversion does not cross a New Year boundary.
